card.name: Prepositions before place names in regional history
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as at, in, the, for and across just before a place name, mostly in Western Australian and Indian history or culture passages. It marks where a proper place name is expected next.

modes.label: Preposition before a place
modes.description: A word like at, for or across right before a named town, river site or region.
modes.example: Creating the bends in the river<< at>> Belmont and Maylands as he went.

modes.label: Linking word in religious or cultural text
modes.description: A word such as in or the before a faith, sect or group name in Indian history lists.
modes.example: a central text<< in>> the Swaminarayan Faith sect of

card.writes: It pushes toward place names, especially Indian and southern African ones such as Gujarat and Natal, plus some Chinese characters.
card.plain: It fires on small words like "at" or "in" when a place name is about to follow in a history passage.
